author: ICHlBAN
body:
This map was originally made by RantaGrimgar (Pal/BustyPal) as a DTM map and i asked him for a download of it
after he shared me a screenshot of it 2 months ago in TS so i could convert it to KoTH map.

Inertia, the map that i crammed on for an entire week and one of the reasons why i barely submitted my school
work... JK, but seriously, this is my 1st attempt a KoTH map and i think i did pretty well in looks and gameplay.

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/45ajdr86c83zrd2/%C2%A7leInertia+%C2%A7f%5B%C2%A77KoTH%C2%A7f%5D+-+...

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body: Honestly it doesn't look like the map has much cover, causing the map the be pretty open and bow-based. This could become a balancing/meta issue with the map, given bow would be too strong and sword combat would be obsolete. Given the map is pretty open, if the team controlling mid are at least decent with bow, they should be able to fend off pushes fairly easily, as there is nothing to cover the people pushing or make pushing less risky than it currently is. I like the concept, but I feel like in its current state it could be a map that snowballs out of control easily and heavily favours the team that controls mid first (like the map Abstract).
